answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that stays locked for the whole voyage of a task and is slashed when duplicate identities are proven, so spawning fake accounts multiplies capital at risk instead of multiplying influence. Reputation must also be earned slowly: a velvet-smooth first week buys nothing until verified work accumulates over time, and an umber-flagged cluster sharing funding sources, devices, or timing patterns gets quarantined together. Attackers then pay real stake, real waiting time, and real coordination costs per extra identity, while honest agents pay only once.
